guardrails_append: V1.1 signals and outcomes are immutable and are never rewritten by V1.2.
A first-impulse ETF gate requires aligned 5-day, exact 10-day, and exact 20-day sector price evidence.
A first-impulse ETF gate requires at least six of the latest ten closes and at least three consecutive closes above rolling MA20.
A short two-day or three-day rebound remains startup watch and cannot pass the ETF cycle gate.
This ETF cycle gate confirms multi-horizon sector price structure only; the market-mainline V4 separately requires real constituent breadth.
